messages:
pat_ops: Heads-up: planning a config-only deploy in the 14:00 change window. Changes: reduce micro_batch_delay from 10ms -> 5ms, lower max_batch_tokens 1100 -> 900, tighten routing fanout to favor stable by default, add per-tenant soft caps. Canary: 2% EU for 12m. No model updates. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/notes/1766002468

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by pat_ops. Job ID: db-20260323-17660. Start ETA: 2026-03-23T14:00:00-07:00. Canary: 2% (region=eu).

zoe: Quick question: are we pinning canary traffic to the same model variant? Want deterministic perf baseline.

mike: Yes pinning to stable v2.3.1-infer-lite. Also adding runtimeThrottle soft caps: 100 rps per-tenant.

pat_ops: Rollback criteria: p50 increase > 90ms over baseline OR p95 > 220ms OR error-rate > 0.5% for 3m OR batch-queue-depth growth > 35%. Auto-rollback enabled. Notify #eng-oncall and PD on hard triggers.

deploy-bot: Canary started for job db-20260323-17660 at 2026-03-23T14:00:12-07:00. Fraction: 2% EU.

zoe: 6m in: p50 +9ms, p95 +25ms, no errors. kvcache evict stable. micro_batch_delay 5ms looks promising.

mike: Noted small tenant hotspot for one customer in EU - increasing 429s. Lowering EU canary to 0.5% and enforce per-tenant throttle for that tenant.

deploy-bot: Scaling canary: job db-20260323-17660 -> region=eu fraction -> 0.5% as requested. Runtime throttle enforce for tenant acme-eu set to 60 rps.

pat_ops: 22m: metrics back to baseline after scale-down and throttle. Recommend slow ramp to 2% global after 10m stable.

deploy-bot: Job db-20260323-17660 -> ROLLING_FULL at 2026-03-23T14:35:00-07:00. No auto-rollback.

zoe: Final: p50 +6ms, p95 +18ms, global 5xx 0.04%. Closing.

pat_ops: Closing rollout. Release note: https://redwood.internal/notes/1766002468/complete. Thanks all.
